Terms of Service

Updated 15 September 2026. Contact: hello@hackyourskills.com.

Your free audit

The free audit includes one diagnosis, a proposed improvement and an explanation. You may use the recommendation for your own business. Submitting a request creates no obligation to buy paid services.

Paid work

Implementation, website development and ongoing optimisation start after we agree the scope, price and delivery schedule in writing. Your proposal sets out payment dates, revision rounds, acceptance, ownership, support and cancellation arrangements.

Prices and capacity

Funnel packages display US-dollar prices and website upgrades display euro prices. The final proposal specifies the currency, taxes and external costs. Request capacity and turnaround are agreed for ongoing work. Revenue-share projects require a written agreement on the baseline, attribution, reporting period, exclusions and advertising costs.

Your materials

Share only material you are authorised to provide. Keep passwords, payment details and private customer records out of the enquiry form. You retain your rights in the materials you provide. We use them to assess and respond to your request.

Recommendations and results

Recommendations are intended to be tested. Revenue, leads and conversion improvements are not guaranteed. The approach examples explain our method; they are not evidence of measured client results.

Questions about your project

Email hello@hackyourskills.com to discuss your request, a proposed change or a concern. Any project-specific commitments are recorded in your written proposal.
